infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: IndoFleet Delivery App needs location access to track real-time delivery telemetry.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: IndoFleet Delivery App requires continuous background GPS to sync delivery tracking with Command Center.

plugins.cameraPermission: Allow IndoFleet Delivery App to access your camera for drone QR scanning and airframe safety inspection.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Allow IndoFleet Delivery App to use your location for real-time delivery navigation and flight tracking.

plugins.cameraPermission: Allow IndoFleet Delivery App to take camera photos for Proof of Delivery (POD).
plugins.photosPermission: Allow IndoFleet Delivery App to access your photos for Proof of Delivery (POD).

plugins.microphonePermission: Allow IndoFleet Delivery App to record audio for emergency SOS voice transmission.
